verdict.rationale: A filing portal for company formalities could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment for integrators, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only the production filing flows (deposits, payment, signature, tracking) and never mentions a sandbox or test environment. The keyless recherche-entreprises API probe is a separate state data API and a read-only production endpoint, not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
